event_chain.summary: Cloud environment accessed May 10-12; user account data involved

summary: Between May 10 and 12, 2026 an unauthorized party accessed VRChat, Inc.'s cloud environment. VRChat detected and contained the activity and engaged outside experts. Usernames, linked email addresses, VRChat+ subscription status, login history including device identifiers and IP addresses, and linked Steam or Meta user IDs were involved; passwords, payment cards and ID documents were not. VRChat filed a notice with the Maine attorney general and notified users on June 10, without disclosing the number affected.
